This name is mentioned in the Quran as the name of a disciple of Prophet Jesus (pbuh). The name Butrus carries the meaning “Son of the Resurrector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Butrus usually hope their child will grow to embody son of the resurrector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
